name: Refatoração — Thread B: Command Dispatch
description: Extrair handlers de comandos, criar CommandRegistry, e extrair dispatcher do main. Esta thread DEVE rodar e mergear PRIMEIRO — as demais dependem de US-004.

userStories.title: Extrair handlers de ctl, service, tui, doctor e daemon start
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want each top-level command (ctl, service, tui, doctor, daemon start) to have its own handler module so the entrypoint is no longer a cascade of branches.
acceptanceCriteria: O main() delega a esses handlers sem conter a lógica de cada um
Comportamento externo dos comandos permanece idêntico

userStories.title: Criar CommandHandler e CommandRegistry
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a central command registry where each command declares its name, expected arguments, handler, required context, and exit code so that dispatching is data-driven.
acceptanceCriteria: Definir tipo CommandHandler com campos: name, args, handler proc, required context, exit code
Implementar CommandRegistry com register(), resolve(), e dispatch()
Migrar pelo menos um comando existente (ex: ctl) para usar o registry
Adicionar testes unitários para register e resolve

userStories.title: Extrair dispatcher de comandos do main
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the main file to no longer contain the long cascade of command branches so that composition root is lean.
acceptanceCriteria: O main() apenas: carrega config, valida pré-condições, monta dependências, delega ao dispatcher
Todos os comandos ctl, service, tui, doctor, start são roteados via CommandRegistry
Exit codes são padronizados por comando
Adicionar testes de despacho de comandos sem boot do daemon
